meta.title: The Waystation
meta.premise: Kael has found a rail depot turned safe house called the Waystation, and keeps coming back to it between runs for whatever the board by the gate turns up next.

board.title: The Sick Room
board.pitch: Someone in the east wing is running a fever no one will name — whoever finds what's wrong gets first pick of the medicine cabinet.

board.title: The Supply Drop
board.pitch: A drop from before the quiet went out over the old band an hour ago, west past the rail yard — whoever gets there first gets to split it.

board.title: The Sanctuary Rumor
board.pitch: A runner swears there's a sanctuary full of survivors clear across the city, gate guarded and lit — worth checking before word spreads and the road fills up.

opening.title: The Waystation
opening.question: Rations at the Waystation run three days short of the month, and Harlan's gate log says who has earned their bunk.
opening.situation: The Waystation fills an old rail depot behind a fence of scavenged sheet metal, its yard lit by a single working floodlight. Harlan Voss counts the gate log by lantern light while Dee Okafor stacks crates against a wall nobody trusts anymore.
opening.secret: Harlan trades names off the gate log to a scavenger crew outside for extra rations, and Mara Fenn has seen him do it twice.

harlan-voss.name: Harlan Voss
harlan-voss.brief: Keeps the Waystation's gate locked and its ledger straight; nobody gets in or out without his say.

dee-okafor.name: Dee Okafor
dee-okafor.brief: A regular who trades salvage for a bunk and never asks where anyone's been.

mara-fenn.name: Mara Fenn
mara-fenn.brief: Watches the gate from the rafters and says nothing to anyone who hasn't proven themselves.

payload.source: An old rail depot turned safe house, its gate log deciding who eats and who doesn't.
